caption:
For the neighbor you only ever wave at

The Prophet ﷺ said that Gabriel kept recommending kind and polite treatment of neighbors, so much that he thought Gabriel would order him to make them his heirs. Check on one neighbor this week.

Sahih al-Bukhari 6014 · Grade: Sahih

Knock on one neighbor's door this week with something small
